steps.name: Sample structure QC and low-depth sample inspection

grounding.reason: Sample structure QC (blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap) per R-0033@40bf; low-depth sample kept, inspected and reported per R-0008@440d — removal only with a stated reason, not by default.

acceptance_criteria: Library size and detected-gene count reported per sample, with sample_01 explicitly compared to the group median
Blind VST computed and PCA plotted on the top 500 most variable genes, colored by condition

A stated, evidence-based decision on whether sample_01 is kept or removed for the downstream DE step, not a silent default

steps.name: PyDESeq2 differential expression: AD lesional vs control
steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes are differentially expressed between AD lesional (n=6) and control (n=6) skin, using PyDESeq2 with control as the reference level, minimal pre-filtering, apeglm-equivalent LFC shrinkage, and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05?

grounding.reason: PyDESeq2 Wald test with median-of-ratios normalization internal to the model and apeglm-equivalent shrinkage per R-0001@9a17/R-0009@f54e; BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05 per R-0010@91a5. R-0018@a472 (tximport length offsets) not applied because the input is already a gene-level count matrix, not transcript-level Salmon quant files.

acceptance_criteria: Pre-filter keeps a gene only if it has >=10 counts in >=6 samples (the smaller group size); filter is minimal, not aggressive
DeseqDataSet built with design ~condition, reference level explicitly set to control, and contrast named (condition, lesional, control) so a positive LFC means higher in lesional
Wald test run; DeseqStats.lfc_shrink() applied to report a shrunken log2FoldChange alongside the unshrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE
Results table reports padj (BH, independent filtering on) at alpha=0.05, with the number of genes tested and the number significant
MA plot and dispersion plot produced as fit diagnostics; p-value histogram produced and inspected before trusting the BH adjustment
Genes with an NA p-value from the Cook's-distance outlier flag (since n=6 per group is below 7) are reported separately from genes removed by independent filtering
sample_01 handling decision from T1S1 is applied and stated in this step's output

steps.name: Preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene sets (and, as a follow-up, which Reactome pathways) are enriched among genes ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic for the AD lesional vs control contrast?

grounding.reason: Preranked GSEA on the full tested-gene list against MSigDB Hallmark human (staged at /mnt/refs/managed/msigdb-hallmark-human/2026.1/) per R-0048@500d, then Reactome (staged at /mnt/refs/managed/reactome-pathways/current/) per R-0165@e456. Ranking metric chosen as the Wald statistic (disputed choice per R-0108@409f, resolved here in favor of the DESeq2 test statistic since no ashr/coefficient-mixing issue applies).

acceptance_criteria: Every tested gene (post pre-filter, pre significance-threshold) ranked by the Wald 'stat' column from T1S2 — no pre-thresholding of the ranked list
gseapy prerank run against the MSigDB Hallmark human collection (50 sets, HGNC symbols) with gene set size window 15-500 applied after intersecting with tested genes
A second prerank pass run against the Reactome human pathway gene sets (filtered to Homo sapiens via the Reactome pathway index) with the same rank metric and size window
BH-adjusted q-values reported per gene set for each collection separately (not merged/pooled across collections)
Leading-edge genes listed for every significant gene set in each collection
Share of gene symbols that failed to map/intersect with each collection's gene universe reported
Both collection names and versions (MSigDB 2026.1 Hallmark; Reactome 'current' release) stated in the output

plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 AD lesional, 6 control, single batch, unpaired) go through PyDESeq2 in Python end-to-end per the user's Python-only constraint. Step 1 runs sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library-size barplot) before any filtering or testing, so that sample_01 (~4x below median library size) is inspected on its own merits rather than silently dropped or silently kept per rule R-0008. Step 2 fits PyDESeq2 (minimal pre-filter of >=10 counts in >=6 samples, median-of-ratios size factors internal to the model, Wald test, explicit reference level = control, contrast named condition: lesional vs control, apeglm-equivalent shrinkage of the reported log2 fold change, BH adjustment with independent filtering at alpha 0.05). Step 3 runs preranked GSEA (gseapy) on the Wald statistic against the MSigDB Hallmark human collection (50 sets) present in the reference store, with a Reactome follow-up pass per rule R-0165, both restricted to the tested-gene universe with the 15-500 gene-set size window. Step 4 assembles the consolidated report: DE gene table (unshrunken and shrunken LFC), MA/dispersion/p-value-histogram diagnostics, low-depth-sample handling rationale, enrichment tables with leading-edge genes for both collections, and full reproducibility record (package versions, seed, collection releases).
